# Getting help

district-assurance is a modular TypeScript engine for trusted phone calls, maintained by
Distronode under the Apache License 2.0. Where to go depends on what you are asking about.

- **A question, a bug or an idea:** [Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-assurance/issues),
  through the bug report, feature request or question form. The
  [README](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-assurance#readme), [SPEC.md](../SPEC.md)
  and [ROADMAP.md](../ROADMAP.md) answer most questions, so they are worth a look first.
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-assurance/security/advisories/new),
  or if you cannot use GitHub, email opensource@distronode.com. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue for one.
- **A problem with a running service built on this code:** report it to that service's operator.
  This repository answers for its code, not for anyone's deployment (see SECURITY.md, "Scope").

⚠️ **This is a small, pre-alpha project, not a support desk.** We read issues about
district-assurance and fix the ones we can reproduce.
